Quick build / render / test guidance
- No project-level build, test, or lint scripts were detected.
- To render a single Quarto document (if Quarto is used):

- To render the whole project/site (if configured):

High-level architecture
- cases/ — Quarto case studies. Each case usually has a source .qmd and a generated .html. Treat the .qmd as the source of truth and regenerate HTML with Quarto.
- slides/ — One directory per talk (slides/talk01, slides/talk02, ...). These directories hold slide sources and exported outputs.
- Rendered outputs (.html) may be committed in-place. When editing content, edit .qmd sources and re-render.

Key conventions and patterns
- Prefer editing .qmd source files (under cases/ and slides/) instead of editing compiled .html outputs.
- Talk directories use the pattern slides/talkNN; follow existing naming for new talks.
- Quarto frontmatter (YAML) drives output formats and execution engines. Inspect frontmatter for required engines (R, python, etc.) and any knitr/execute options.
- There is no detected package manager manifest (no package.json, requirements.txt, environment.yml, DESCRIPTION, or _quarto.yml at repo root). If adding CI or reproducible setups, add a top-level _quarto.yml and an environment manifest and update this file.
